query: Under what circumstances do I have legal rights during an arrest?
reference_answer:
Rights if Arrested:
If arrested, you have the right to:
* Know the reason for arrest
* Contact a family member or lawyer
* Remain silent
* Request medical attention, if needed
answer: During an arrest, you generally have the right to remain silent and to have an attorney present, as guaranteed by the Fifth Amendment. You also have the right to be informed of the reason for the arrest and to request a phone call if needed. [System]
